text: なんど　いわせるのよ？

structure.en: are you going to make me say it?

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: The せる ending turns 'do' into 'make someone do'. いう is 'to say', so いわせる = 'make me say'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a question asks for an explanation, and with よ it sounds annoyed. いわせるのよ = 'just how many times will you make me say it'.
